description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
Fix for Story Issues / Minor Rendering Improvements

A smaller update this time around just to ensure that those stuck in the story get their fix as soon as possible. I'm still working on the next big update, so stay tuned for that!

# Improvements

- Tweaked some visual stylings
- Improved some issues with VN elements misrendering in Tutorial
- Improved pausing with VN elements
- Added some more fun? 🤔

# Fixes

- All known race conditions causing softlocks in story mode are now fixed. (If you previously got stuck in story mode download the update and you should be good now.)
